title: Headlines
about: The newest stories of a news feed: when it last updated, then one row per story with its source above the title.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Headlines" from my news feed sensor (sensor.news): its attribute updated says when it last updated and its attribute stories is a JSON list of {t: title, s: source and age}. A section header with the update time, then one row per story (up to six), the source above the title.
better: A tap on a story does nothing yet: opening the full story is still to come, so the rows have no chevron.

title: AI agents
about: Your AI agents at a glance: how many are working, then a tile per agent with its mascot in the mood of what it is doing and how far it has got.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "AI agents": the number of agents working as the big number (sensor.agents_working), then a grid of agent tiles three across for sensor.agent_firmware, sensor.agent_docs, sensor.agent_review, sensor.agent_tests, sensor.agent_media and sensor.agent_audit, the ones that need me first, then working, done and idle (state working, needs, done or idle; attribute status = how far it has got, as "3 of 5").
better: The tiles have nothing to open yet: a screen per agent is still to come. The order is fixed in the spec: a grid that sorts its tiles by state is still to come.

title: Shopping list
about: A tick-off shopping list from a to-do list: what is left to buy with a count, and what is already in the basket.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Shopping list" from todo.shopping (its state is how many are left; attribute to_buy and attribute basket are JSON lists of item names): a caption with the count left, one checkbox per item to buy, then the ticked ones under "in the basket".
better: Ticking an item changes the count here, but the to-do list itself is not updated yet: Facet has no to-do action.

title: Medication
about: Today's doses: the next one big with what to take, a box to tick for each dose, and how long the pack will last.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Medication": how long until the next dose big (sensor.next_dose attribute in_hours) with its time and the medicine beside it, today's four doses as checkboxes, then two rows: tablets left and when to reorder.

title: Energy price
about: The electricity price now as the big number, today's 24 hourly prices as bars coloured cheap to peak with now marked, and the cheapest and dearest times.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Energy price" from my Octopus Agile sensors: the price now big (sensor.electricity_price, pence per kWh) with the band beside it, a full-width bar chart of the 24 hourly prices (attribute today, a comma list) coloured by band with now (attribute hour) marked, then two rows: the cheapest slot and the peak.
better: The chart has no hour labels under it yet, and reading a bar by pressing it would say kWh, not pence: it is left off here.

title: Living room lights
about: Every light in the room as a tile: a lit one shows its bulb and state in the accent colour, a tap switches it; the ceiling dimmer below.
prompt: Make a Facet screen "Living room lights": a three-column grid of tiles for light.lounge_ceiling, light.lounge_sofa_lamp, light.lounge_reading_lamp, light.lounge_shelves, light.lounge_tv_glow and light.lounge_fireplace (a tap toggles each), then a full-width slider for the ceiling light's brightness.
